summary: The market-entry opportunity appears commercially attractive and coherent enough for controlled validation, but it is not launch-commitment-ready until legal, customs, certification, landed-cost, service, lease, and partner evidence gaps are closed.
strongest_reason_to_proceed: The Kazakhstan use case and commercial objective are specific enough to start advisor requests, quote collection, and partner validation.
strongest_reason_to_pause: The current evidence pack is not sufficient for signature, import, lease, first-batch order, advertising spend, or partner appointment.
confirmed_facts: A company profile and product or project description were supplied.
The decision question is at pre-signature stage.
Known blockers include missing legal, customs, certification, lease, and service evidence.
assumptions: Public cost benchmarks are not signed quotes.
Supplier prices are not Kazakhstan landed costs.
The final commercial structure depends on local legal, tax, customs, and operational review.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Written recommendation on branch, representative office, LLP, distributor, importer, or dealer structure.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The legal form affects sales, import, service, tax, contracting, and liability.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Assessment of whether the chosen entry model (branch, representative office, LLP, or direct contracting) creates a taxable permanent establishment or resident status.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Permanent-establishment and residency treatment drive tax registration, reporting load, and the real cost of the entry model.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Request a permanent-establishment and tax-residency memo for each candidate entry model.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Note on currency-contract registration thresholds, repatriation reporting, and how supplier payments and profit repatriation will clear local banks.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Currency-control registration and repatriation reporting affect how, and how quickly, money can move in and out after commitment.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Confirm currency-contract registration and repatriation steps with the servicing bank.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: HS code, duty, VAT, import classification, and documentation memo.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The landed-cost model and import feasibility cannot be confirmed without customs treatment.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Send catalogue, specs, packing list, and Incoterms for review.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Kazakhstan or EAEU certification and road-use classification path by product category.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Commercial sales and customer-facing claims may depend on classification and conformity requirements.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Real lease offer with availability, area, rent, service charges, deposit, and permitted use.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Showroom cost assumptions remain benchmark-only until confirmed by lease offers.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Request lean, base, and premium location offers.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Service partner, mechanic, warranty process, spare-parts list, and service SLA.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: After-sales readiness is required before advertising or large-volume sales.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Identify service partner and define minimum launch service promise.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Trademark filing or registration status in Kazakhstan (national or EAEU/Madrid) for the brand and key product names, plus a third-party-filing / squatting check.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Public brand promotion before the mark is secured invites squatting; most brand disputes surface within months of launch, and an unsecured mark can block the launch it was meant to support.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Run a clearance search and file the core classes before any public promotion or advertising spend.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Whether the planned website, lead capture, CRM, app, or fleet data triggers Kazakhstan personal-data localization, and how citizen data will be stored in-country (including backups).
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Personal-data localization can apply even through a distributor without a local entity; non-compliance risks fines and operational disruption once customer data is collected.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Map data flows and confirm in-country storage before launching lead capture or the app.
evidence_gaps.decision_blocked: Customer data collection and app/lead-gen launch.

claim_audit.claim: Kazakhstan is a credible entry market.
claim_audit.how_to_use_now: Use as an executive thesis, not as proof of demand.

claim_audit.claim: The project can move to controlled validation.
claim_audit.how_to_use_now: Use for advisor requests, quotes, and structured customer or partner interviews.

claim_audit.claim: The project is ready for launch commitment.
claim_audit.how_to_use_now: Do not use. Replace with validation-ready until evidence gaps are closed.

owner_actions.action: Send evidence request to partner and advisors.
owner_actions.output: Missing-document checklist and advisor request pack.
